<thought>We need to determine how many carbonyl (C=O) groups are present in the unknown molecule. The easiest way is to look at the 13C NMR spectrum, where carbonyl carbons appear in the downfield region (~190‑220 ppm). By counting the distinct peaks in that region we can infer the number of carbonyl groups.</thought>
